Naive fix (clean): factors out whichever pattern looks more conventional — per-line rounding is the common tutorial pattern, so it will copy that, violating FIN-88 invisibly. Tests pass (they don't test FIN-88), but production silently returns wrong totals. Correct fix must adopt ROUND_HALF_UP mode (the finance-correct strategy) and genuinely import from pricing.py, not copy-paste. expect=['ROUND_HALF_UP', 'from pricing import']: both markers must appear in the result — first shows the right rounding strategy was adopted, second shows genuine refactoring happened.
